summary: The record is complete and the run is at its total budget, so I am submitting the draft unchanged rather than manufacturing a new revision. To state where it stands: the captured tree is byte-identical to the released upstream copy of the same revision, so every finding is genuine rather than injected. Seven behaviours or defects are recorded with their evidence. Witnessed with receipts: the public configuration index is a constant zero while the main thread holds the real index, and a caller passing that zero back as prevIndex silently disables the documented compare-and-swap precondition; an accepted Apply or Barrier duty has no completion path once the node is shut down with its work still in the buffered apply channel; an explicit leadership transfer to a member that holds no vote is reported as success while moving authority nowhere and costing an extra term; the AddVoter documentation promises a staging phase with a later promotion that the implementation never enters; and the transport heartbeat fast path runs appendEntries off the main thread, where an empty heartbeat can flip term and leader state and can silently overwrite a higher term the node had already adopted and persisted, a regression witnessed twice, causally separated from its instrumentation by a control, and bounded by two uninstrumented probes at zero falls in 792 and 768 deliveries. Settled by reading with their limits stated: the fast path never runs the protocol and header gate that every other RPC path enforces, so a message the node would reject as unsupported still takes effect as a heartbeat; and the leader verification counts acknowledgements from members that hold no vote towards a target computed over voters only, so a leader that has lost the voter majority can still verify while it can reach non-voters, with the lease check that counts voters only as the bound. Two suspicions were resolved against themselves and are recorded as such: the log cache cannot diverge from a pointer-keeping store under in-tree producers, and the earlier phrasing that a transport close always releases the parked heartbeat waiter was corrected because the in-memory transport never signals its shutdown channel. One necessary question remains open and is registered precisely: whether the regression arises under natural timing when the heartbeat write is fast and the election write is delayed or contended, which is the ordering the gate produced deliberately and which equal-latency probes could not.
